2nd World Lagomorph Conference


The Research Center in Biodiversity and Genetic Resources of the University
of Porto (CIBIO/UP) in collaboration with the Research Institute of Wildlif=
e
Ecology, University of Veterinary Medicine Vienna and the IUCN/SSC
Lagomorph Specialist Group, are pleased to invite you to attend the 2nd
World Lagomorph Conference that will be held in July 2004 at Vair=E3o,
Portugal.

The 2nd World Lagomorph Conference aims to bring together lagomorph
researchers from all over the world. It will provide an excellent opportuni=
ty to
discuss the latest news and developments in Lagomorph biology, ecology,
systematics, physiology, paleontology, pathology, genetics, phylogeography,
wildlife management, etc. Following the great success of the 1st World
Lagomorph Conference 25 years ago, and several Lagomorph meetings, it is
now time to organize such an event. Thus, we invite all lagomorph researche=
rs
and people interested in this mammal group to attend this conference.
Detailed information concerning the conference is available on
http://cibio.up.pt/lagconf/.

Paulo C=E9lio Alves, Nuno Ferrand, Klaus Hackl=E4nder and Franz Suchentrunk=
